absent.description: false waits for at least one match; true waits for none.

timeout.description: Maximum wait in seconds (1–600, default 60). Returns matched=false on expiry; not an error.

interval.description: Seconds between poll starts (minimum 3). If another poll does not fit, waits until expiry; count is from the last completed poll.
